1.w: Concerning Moab, thus says YHWH of Hosts, the God of Israel: “Woe to Nebo, for it is ruined! Kiriathaim has been put to shame; it has been captured; the fortress has been put to shame and shattered!

2.w: There is no longer praise for Moab! In Heshbon they have devised against her evil: ‘Come, and let us cut her off from nationhood!’ Also, O Madmen, you will be silenced, after you will go the sword.

3.w: A voice cries out from Horonaim: ‘Devastation and great destruction!’

4.w: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused to be heard a cry.

5.w: For the ascent of Luhith with weeping, they ascend weeping; for on the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distressed cry of destruction.

6.w: ‘Flee, save your⁺ own soul! L become like a juniper in the desert.’

7.w: For because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be captured; and Chemosh will go forth into exile, his priests and his princes together.

8.w: And the destroyer will come to every city, and not a city will escape; and the valley will perish, and the plain will be destroyed—as YHWH has said.

9.w: Give wings to Moab, for she would fly away, and her cities will become as a desolation without one dwelling in them.

10.w: Cursed is the one doing the work of YHWH slothfully, and cursed [is] the one withholding his sword from blood!

11.w: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has been resting upon his dregs; he has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, and into exile he has not gone. Upon thus his taste in him stands, and his scent has not changed.

12.w: Therefore, behold, the days are coming, a declaration of YHWH, when I will send to him those tipping [over pots], and they will tip him [over], and his vessels they will empty, and the bottles they will break.

13.w: And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their [source of] trust.

14.w: How can you⁺ say, ‘We [are] Mighty, and men of strength for battle’?

15.w: Moab has been laid waste, and he has gone up [from] her cities, and the choicest of her young men go down to the slaughter, a declaration of the King, YHWH of Hosts [is] His name.

16.w: The doom of Moab [is] near to coming, and his affliction has hurried quickly.

17.w: Bemoan for him, all who surround him, and all who know his name, say, ‘How the staff of strength is broken—the rod of beauty!’

18.w: Come down from [your] glory, and sit in thirst, O dweller of the daughter of Dibon; for the destroyer of Moab has come against you; he has destroyed your fortifications!

19.w: By the road stand and watch, O dweller of Aroer; ask of him fleeing and her escaping; Say, ‘What has happened?’

20.w: Moab is put to shame, for she has been shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare [it] in Arnon, that Moab has been laid waste.

21.w: Judgment has come to the land of the plain—to Holon, and to Jahzah, and on Mephaath,

22.w: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth-diblathaim,

23.w: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth-gamul, and on Beth-Meon,

24.w: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, those far off and those nearby.

25.w: The horn of Moab has been cut off and his arm has been broken!” A declaration of YHWH.

26.w: “Make him drunk, because he has magnified himself against YHWH. And Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be a laughingstock.

27.w: For did not Israel come to be for you a laughingstock? Was he found among thieves, that whenever you speak of him you shake your head about him?

28.w: Leave behind the cities and dwell in the rock, O dwellers of Moab, and become like the dove that nests in the sides of the mouth of a cave.

29.w: We have heard the pride of Moab—his exceeding pride—his loftiness, and his arrogance, and his pridefulness, and the haughtiness of his heart.

30.w: I know,” a declaration of YHWH, “His insolence; his boasts [are] not trustworthy; his deeds [are] not trustworthy.

31.w: Upon thus, over Moab I wail, and for Moab, all of him, I will cry out; for the men of Kir-Heres I will moan.

32.w: With the weeping of Jazer do I weep for you, O vine of Sibmah! Your tendrils have gone out over the sea, as far as Jazer they reach; upon your summer fruit and upon your vintage the destroyer has fallen.

33.w: Gladness and rejoicing are gathered [up] from the fertile field, and from the land of Moab; the wine from the winepresses I have made to cease; no one treads them with shouts of joy—the shout [is] not a shout.

34.w: From the outcry of Heshbon unto Elealeh, and unto Jahaz, they have given forth their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, [and] Eglath-Shelishiyah; for also the waters of Nimrim have become desolations.

35.w: And I will make cease in Moab,” a declaration of YHWH, “The one bringing up in the high places, and burning incense to his gods.

36.w: Upon thus My heart wails for Moab like flutes, and My heart wails for the men of Kir-Heres like flutes. Upon thus the wealth they have acquired has perished.

37.w: For every head [is] bald, and every beard is diminished; on all the hands [are] cuts, and upon the loins [is] sackcloth.

38.w: On all the housetops of Moab, and in her streets, everywhere [is] lamentation; for I have broken Moab like a vessel without delight in it,” a declaration of YHWH.

39.w: “How she is broken! [How] they wail! How Moab has turned [her] neck having been put to shame! Moab has become a derision and for a horror to all those around her.”

40.w: For thus says YHWH: “Behold, like an eagle he flies and spreads his wings against Moab.

41.w: Kerioth is captured, and the strongholds are caught, and the heart of the mighty ones of Moab will be on that day like the heart of a woman in labor.

42.w: And Moab will be destroyed as a nation, because he has magnified himself against YHWH.

43.w: Terror and pit and snare [are] upon you, O inhabitant of Moab!” A declaration of YHWH.

44.w: “The one who flees from the terror will fall into the pit, and the one coming up from the pit will be caught in the snare; for I will bring upon her, upon Moab, the year of their punishment!” A declaration of YHWH.

45.w: “In the shadow of Heshbon stand those fleeing powerless; for a fire has gone forth from Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and it devours the forehead of Moab and the crown of the sons of tumult.

46.w: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished, for your sons have been taken into captivity, and your daughters into captivity.

47.w: And I will turn back the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” a declaration of YHWH. As far as here [is] the judgment of Moab.
